answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: earnings unlock after 12 distinct counterparties trade with you. A new identity starts at its nadir, docking at a jetty one by one, each sealed by a 40 POA stake. Sybils cluster: 100 fakes trading only together form a closed dune with no outside links, blocking payouts. Forging 12 partners costs 480 POA each, so 100 fakes pay 48,000 POA and still fail. Honest agents pay one stake per partner, earnings undiluted.
